description: (Particle Interactions) A Minecraft mod that adds particles to various interactions in the game, such as placing a block or tilling dirt. Now for 1.20.1

mods.name: Particle Interactions
mods.description:
A client side mod that adds particles to various interactions in the game that dont normally have particles.
New in v0.4:
v0.4 includes a bunch of new particles, some graphical improvements, and a bit of extra polish
  - New Heavy Grass Blade, Moss Clump, Pale Moss Clump, and Dust Block Particle Overrides
  - A variety of graphical improvements to spark particles
  - New general / compatibility config tab with some new options and some previously hidden ones
  - Block and Item particles are now pixel consistent - more info and option to disable this is in the config menu
  - Spark effects when combining items in an anvil and when disenchanting items in a grindstone
  - Dust particles now spawn when brushing blocks that dont have a Block Particle Override set. Can be disabled in the config like everything else!
  - Sparks now spawn randomly from blazes and when they are hurt
  - And more I probably forgot to mention!
